The most likely answer is **C**, cell death in the areas with high dopamine cell density. I'm revising my earlier answer, since the team note rules out A and B. Of the two remaining options, chronic heavy use of a dopamine-acting drug, such as methamphetamine, can damage dopamine neurons. That damage would fit a desperate, aggressive demand for medication. Seizure-like activity in dopamine areas isn't a recognised feature of this picture.
